verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents per-video export: finished videos can be downloaded as .mp4 through the API, and the pricing page lists SCORM export. Neither amounts to a documented way to export all account data and leave. missing for 10: bulk or full-account data export, export of scripts/projects/avatars/voices/quiz and survey results in open formats, a documented offboarding or portability process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
